== Description ==
Our new Summer update is finally just around the corner and comes with something really cute and special - Squirrels!! But that's not all - Baby Zebras, a new production machine, new crop, new bush, bagful of new products, a new custom decoration and so much more! 

Keep checking our social media pages for sneak peaks, as well as exclusive update information suck as unlock levels, times etc. - revealed by our aMOOzing YouTubers!
